let n := Nat.card Mˣ
let G := Rˣ
let H := Mˣ
let χs := MulChar M R
let χs' : Finset _ := χs
let χs'' : Finset _ := χs
let h_char_group_isom : χs ≃ₐ[AddCommGroup] H :=
  by
    have h_finite : Fintype H := Fintype.ofFinite (Finite.ofSubtype (Finite M) (Subgroup.isSubgroup_unit M))
    have h_finite_χs : Fintype χs :=
      by
        apply Fintype.finite
        exact (MulChar.finite M R).1
    let h_card_χs : Nat.card χs = Nat.card H :=
      by
        apply Eq.symm
        apply Nat.card_congr
        apply MulChar.char_group_isomorphic_to_units M R
    exact h_card_χs
exact Eq.refl (Nat.card χs) ▸ Nat.card_congr h_char_group_isom
